title: DRF Luftrettung receives approval for hoistAR winch simulator
summary: The company recently received certification for its hoistAR winch simulator from the German Federal Aviation Office.
body_markdown:
DRF Luftrettung (German Air Rescue) recently received certification for its hoistAR winch simulator from the German Federal Aviation Office. ****


This makes it the first air rescue operator in Europe whose winch training syllabus has been certified by a national authority.


In the future, crews at the five stations with winch helicopters will be able to conduct their training virtually – an important supplement to the twice-yearly real-world training sessions.


The ability to link the simulator with the[H145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h145) Full Flight Simulator at LAT Lufthansa Aviation Training in Frankfurt allows for joint training of hoist operators and pilots in “slave to FFS” mode.


To perform the complex procedures of winch rescue safely, professionally, and quickly, crews require regular, intensive, and realistic training.


Until now, this could only be achieved during actual flight. However, with the now-approved mobile winch simulator hoistAR, developed by DRF Luftrettung in collaboration with Reiser Simulation and Training, a range of virtual training opportunities is now available.
Based on XR (Extended Reality) technology, the simulator enables training for pilots and hoist operators—the crew members who stand on the skid—regardless of the time of day or weather.


This provides emergency responders with an additional way to train for operational scenarios, prepare themselves optimally for current and future challenges, and further enhance the safety of crews and patients.


A unique feature of the simulator is that all the technology is housed in a trailer, making it mobile and location-independent, allowing hoist operators to train independently in “stand-alone” mode.


Trainees therefore do not need to travel to a simulation center.


Another advantage – and at the same time a unique selling point of the hoistAR: It can be coupled with the[H145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h145) Full Flight Simulator at LAT Lufthansa Aviation Training in Frankfurt.


This enables joint training of hoist operators and pilots in “slave to FFS” mode. A concept that is unique worldwide and opens up new perspectives in winch training.


More information about hoistAR can be found at:[https://www.drf-akademie.de/hoistar](https://www.drf-akademie.de/hoistar)


## **This is what the hoistAR offers**


- Two training modes: “Stand alone” (training hoist operator) and “Slave to FFS” (coupling with the FFS, training hoist operator/pilot)
- Mobile usability: Setup and dismantling in the shortest possible time
- XR (Extended Reality) technology: uniting the digital and real worlds
- XY-axes motion platform: Adaptation to changing flight attitudes or weather conditions
- Realistic cable & load movement
- High-end system fidelity level


## **The advantages for users**


- Training independent of time of day and weather
- Increased safety in real-world operations: Repeated and individualized training of emergency procedures and individual sequences of the winch procedure is possible.
- Use of an ecologically sustainable system
- Increased availability of the aircraft fleet due to reduced commitment for training purposes.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by DRF Luftrettung. It has been translated with an online service.*
